subject: Offer approval: Priya Desai — L3 Software Engineer
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: Priya Desai - L3 Software Engineer (standard)

Hi team,

Attached is the recommended offer package for Priya Desai for the L3 Software Engineer role (req #SWE-314). Quick summary below — details in the attached PDF and the comp matrix.

- Base salary: $155,000 (above midpoint for L3 by ~4%)
- Target bonus: 12% OT (pro-rated first year)
- RSUs: $45,000 grant value, 4-year vesting (25% cliff / monthly thereafter)
- Sign-on: $7,000 (relocation not applicable)
- Start date requested: 2026-10-18
- Cost center: ENG-PLATFORM-3 (headcount approved in Q3 budget; headcount ID HC-2026-314)

Rationale: Priya has strong infra experience, multiple production systems, and a counteroffer from another mid-stage company. The base is slightly above band midpoint to remain competitive; equity aligns to band upper-middle. If we need to pull down base to strictly band midpoint, we risk losing her.

Requesting: approval from Nikhil (final sign-off) and Karthik (comp authority for ENG-PLATFORM) to confirm we can proceed at these numbers. If approved, we'll route the DocuSign and copy Payroll/Finance for processing.

Attachments: PriyaDesai_Offer_L3_SDE.pdf, comp_matrix_Q3.csv

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Sep 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole wrote:
> Attached is the recommended offer package for Priya Desai for the L3 Software Engineer role (req #SWE-314). Quick summary below — details in the attached PDF and the comp matrix.
>
> - Base salary: $155,000 (above midpoint for L3 by ~4%)
> - Target bonus: 12% OT (pro-rated first year)
> - RSUs: $45,000 grant value, 4-year vesting (25% cliff / monthly thereafter)
> - Sign-on: $7,000 (relocation not applicable)
> - Start date requested: 2026-10-18

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) The RSU amount looks OK, but can you confirm the intended vesting cadence (you noted cliff/monthly; is the implementation 25% at 12 months then monthly over 36 months?)
2) Why is base set at $155k vs. our L3 midpoint of $149k? I get the counteroffer rationale; I just want to ensure Finance is looped because that will impact run-rate for the team. Do we have a cost-impact note in the comp_matrix for $155k?
3) Is the sign-on layered (cash + equity) or pure cash? If pure cash, is it taxable gross-up handled by Payroll?

If we can get answers to the above I can provide comp authority sign-off.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Engineering (Platform)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer: Priya Desai - L3 Software Engineer (standard)

Thanks for the quick questions — answers below inline.

1) Vesting cadence: yes, correct — 25% vest at 12 months, then monthly vesting over the next 36 months. Payroll can confirm schedule when onboarding.
2) Base rationale / finance note: we've documented the compensation impact in comp_matrix_Q3.csv (attached). The $155k base increases run-rate by ~$36k annually vs. midpoint; hiring manager (K. Ortega) confirmed priority for this hire due to project criticality. If Finance wants stricter adherence to midpoint, candidate has a firm deadline on another offer. Recommend keeping base and moderating other levers instead (we're at band upper-middle).
3) Sign-on: cash-only, one-time payment of $7,000, paid on first payroll after start. No gross-up.

I've added a short candidate note in the PDF about counteroffer timing. Next step: Nikhil, can you approve the proposed numbers? If yes, I'll generate the DocuSign and route to Payroll/Finance (cc'd once DocuSign is out).

Marissa
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

Approving the package with one small tweak: please increase the one-time sign-on to $10,000 (to sweeten acceptance; total comp still within our approved headcount budget for ENG-PLATFORM-3). All other elements stay as proposed: $155k base, 12% OT bonus, $45k RSU (4y, 25% cliff).

Action items:

- Karthik: acknowledged on comp authority. If Finance flags any issue with run-rate, we'll handle with hiring manager.
